# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.4

## 2026-09-06

## Changed

- Ring Call forwarding set to Smartphone is now accepted as a deliberate
  operating mode (#48). Forwarding only selects which target receives incoming
  Ring Calls; on-demand video, its talkback and Home Call keep working either
  way. Media readiness reports a non-blocking warning instead of `blocked`, and
  no media-setup Repair is raised for it. Keep Smartphone forwarding when the
  Door Entry app should receive calls; select Home Assistant only when Ring
  Calls should be answerable from Home Assistant instead.
- The media-setup Repair never changes Ring Call forwarding anymore. It used to
  switch the device to Home Assistant as part of an unrelated "Fix now", which
  silently took incoming calls away from the Door Entry app.
- The card's readiness chip opens Repairs only for `blocked` or `unavailable`;
  a forwarding warning is informative and no longer rendered as a button.
- The integration is now available from the HACS default repository list. The
  custom-repository install path remains available as a fallback while the
  listing propagates.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant and hard-reload dashboards after updating because the
  bundled C300X card changed.
- The packaged native C300X device agent remains at `1.9.2`; no agent update is
  required for this Home Assistant/frontend-only release.
